Questions

Good to know

Do I need an appointment?

No. Walk-ins are welcome every day from 9 AM to 8 PM. If your situation is unusual, call first so we can tell you what to bring.

How is this different from going to the MVA?

We're a private agency licensed by the Maryland MVA to process tags, titles and registrations. Same state paperwork, no MVA lines, and we're open evenings and weekends. We charge a service fee on top of the state fees; call and we'll quote it for your transaction.

Can you do my driver's license or REAL ID?

No. Driver's licenses, road tests and REAL ID are only handled at an MVA branch. We take care of vehicle tags, titles, registrations and decals.

I just moved to Maryland. How long do I have?

You have 60 days after moving to title and register your vehicle in Maryland. See what to bring.
